description: BC Wildfire Fire Perimeters - Current is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Wildfire Service. Wildfire perimeters for the current fire season, including both active and inactive fires, supplied from various sources. The data is refreshed from operational systems every 15 min. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Wildfire Service. Its tags are area burned, emergency management, fire perimeter, fire polygon, forest fire perimeter. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS_REST, KML, MULTIPLE, ORACLE_SDE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
